newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 35.03 points to 6,348.03. PLDT's ADR dropped by $0 1/8 to $60 3/8.
* The peso closed on Friday at 26.267 to a U.S. dollar from 26.275
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,062.10, down 0.02 points.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was unchanged at 11.0625 pct.

* Stock brokerage firm Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phil) Inc said the market is likely to continue consolidating between the 3,000 to 3,100 level. Attention will continue to be focused on second and thirdliners such as food and property issues and backdoor listings.

* Another brokerage house Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc said: "APEC, though it will bring the country to favorable light on the global area, does not carry any intrinsic value and will thus not suffice to provide the revving force to push the market up." Anscor said the market this week will likely mimic the aimless movement of the broad market index.

* Manila Times newspaper said the 600-strong pilots' union at the Philippine Airlines may have to go on strike anytime after negotiations for a new collective bargaining agreement (CBA) bogged down Friday.
* Inquirer said President Ramos belittled the capability of leftist groups to disrupt the APEC summit at the Subic Freeport.
